purpose: Emphasize an extreme example, often a minimum that fails.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
N + すら / ですら; particle + すら
I could not even remember my own address.
Even the experts hesitated over the answer.
I am so busy I do not even have time to drink water.
formation: N + すら / ですら; particle + すら
restrictions: Often similar to さえ; frequently appears with negatives.
mistake: It is stronger than the ordinary additive も.
